name: HyperFrames Registry Integration
summary: Install and wire existing HyperFrames registry blocks and components into a composition.
problem: Registry items are easy to install incorrectly when their package files, installation location and composition wiring are handled separately.
coreOutcomes: Discover and install an existing registry item
Wire block or component files into the composition
Check the resulting project with the HyperFrames validation workflow
requirements: An existing registry block or component to install
boundaries: This product covers installation and wiring, not authoring or upstream publication of a new registry item
Verify package compatibility rather than assuming it
